name: FillSpread
brief: Enumeration specifying how to fill the area outside the gradient bounds.

members.name: Pad
members.brief: The remaining area is filled with the closest stop color.

members.name: Reflect
members.brief: The gradient pattern is reflected outside the gradient area until the expected region is filled.

members.name: Repeat
members.brief: The gradient pattern is repeated continuously beyond the gradient area until the expected region is filled.
